title: Metabolite accumulation mediates the shift between the High Oxygen Consumption and Low Oxygen Consumption phases in the Yeast Metabolic Cycle
authors: Casani-Galdon S; Xi S; Mellor J; Tarazona S; Conesa A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母代谢周期中代谢物积累对HOC/LOC相变及染色质转录的调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The Yeast Metabolic Cycle (YMC) is a molecular system that serves as a model to study the internal clock that maintains homeostasis in complex organisms. Traditionally, this ultradian rhythm has been studied in the three phases where mature mRNA transcripts show peak accumulation. However, recent studies have shown that the YMC can be interpreted as a two-phase cycle based on altered redox states, known as the high (HOC) and low oxygen consumption (LOC) phases. The length of the HOC phase is fixed and its frequency is nutrient dependent but the nature of the HOC to LOC transition is poorly defined. Here, we use multivariate statistics to integrate metabolic, chromatin and transcriptional changes across the YMC to study the levels of organization that connect them. Our model reveals that both the HOC-LOC and LOC-HOC phase transitions in the YMC are coordinated by accumulating metabolites, reflecting cellular energetics and redox state. We propose that the cycling behavior of chromatin states, transcription and transcripts is a consequence of accumulating metabolites at phase transitions, which function by modulating protein activity and coordinating biochemical pathways to maintain cellular homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 酵母代谢周期（YMC）是一个分子系统，作为研究维持复杂生物体内稳态的内部时钟的模型。传统上，这种超日节律在成熟mRNA转录本显示峰值积累的三个阶段中被研究。然而，近期研究表明，YMC可被解释为基于氧化还原状态改变的两阶段周期，即高耗氧（HOC）和低耗氧（LOC）阶段。HOC阶段的长度是固定的，其频率依赖于营养物，但HOC到LOC转变的性质尚未明确界定。在此，我们使用多元统计学方法，整合YMC中的代谢、染色质和转录变化，以研究连接它们的组织层次。我们的模型揭示，YMC中的HOC-LOC和LOC-HOC阶段转变均由积累的代谢物协调，反映细胞能量状态和氧化还原状态。我们提出，染色质状态、转录和转录本的循环行为是阶段转变时积累代谢物的结果，这些代谢物通过调节蛋白质活性和协调生化途径来维持细胞稳态。
